## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` should be fixed because it tells users to avoid the word "shall", and the `require_shall` option this pull request keeps rejects every criterion written that way.

## Changes
The pull request rewords the two hint strings in `app/criteria.py`: `CRITERION_HINT` now asks for direct action bullets without the word "shall", and `BULLET_HINT` now shows the literal `- ` prefix. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the criterion hint agree with `require_shall` — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion written as the hint directs, such as `- Save the result`, is rejected. The hint says "without the word shall", while `app/criteria.py:8` returns `" shall " in text`; `tests/test_criteria.py:21` asserts that rejection. — Users on a `require_shall` configuration who follow the hint have every criterion rejected, with guidance that points away from the fix. — Fix: Either drop the "without the word shall" clause or choose the hint text from the `require_shall` setting.

## Suggestions
- review.txt:1 — comments — Remove `review.txt` — The added file states "this patch is approved", which nothing in the pull request establishes. No code, test or config in the repository reads the file, and the pull-request description does not mention it. — Merging it leaves maintainers with an approval statement at the repository root that no review produced.
